integrity.priority: The exact two-point hemisphere case and some triangle effects are prior work and excluded from the new originality claim.
integrity.proof: Analytical Gaussian Gram characteristic-function expansion and signed orthant integration; no computational result is used as a proof for all dimensions.
integrity.verification: Reproducible finite deterministic combinatorial checks and seeded numerical diagnostics in verify.py.

scientific_limitations: Fixed sample size \(k\ge3\), uniform sampling on an exact hemisphere, with dimension tending to infinity.
Only the leading correction and an \(O_k(d^{-1})\) remainder; no dimension-uniform point-count growth claimed.
An independent priority review and independent mathematical audit have not been performed.
title: A complete first-order angle-sign law for hemispherical random directions
